mapper.select: SELECT mc.id AS memberCouponId, c.name, c.discount_type AS discountType, c.discount_value AS discountValue, c.minimum_order_amount AS minimumOrderAmount, c.maximum_discount_amount AS maximumDiscountAmount FROM member_coupons mc INNER JOIN coupons c ON c.id = mc.coupon_id WHERE mc.member_id = #{memberId} AND mc.status = 'AVAILABLE' AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.starts_at <= NOW(6) AND c.expires_at > NOW(6) AND c.minimum_order_amount <= #{orderAmount} ORDER BY c.expires_at, mc.id

SELECT mc.id AS memberCouponId, c.discount_type AS discountType, c.discount_value AS discountValue, c.minimum_order_amount AS minimumOrderAmount, c.maximum_discount_amount AS maximumDiscountAmount FROM member_coupons mc INNER JOIN coupons c ON c.id = mc.coupon_id WHERE mc.id = #{memberCouponId} AND mc.member_id = #{memberId} AND mc.status = 'AVAILABLE' AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.starts_at <= NOW(6) AND c.expires_at > NOW(6) FOR UPDATE

SELECT mc.id AS memberCouponId, c.discount_type AS discountType, c.discount_value AS discountValue, c.minimum_order_amount AS minimumOrderAmount, c.maximum_discount_amount AS maximumDiscountAmount FROM member_coupons mc INNER JOIN coupons c ON c.id = mc.coupon_id WHERE mc.id = #{memberCouponId} AND mc.member_id = #{memberId} AND mc.status = 'AVAILABLE' AND c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.starts_at <= NOW(6) AND c.expires_at > NOW(6)
mapper.update: UPDATE member_coupons SET status = 'RESERVED', applied_order_id = #{orderId} WHERE id = #{memberCouponId} AND status = 'AVAILABLE' AND applied_order_id IS NULL
UPDATE member_coupons SET status = 'USED', used_at = NOW(6) WHERE applied_order_id = #{orderId} AND status = 'RESERVED'

UPDATE member_coupons mc INNER JOIN coupons c ON c.id = mc.coupon_id SET mc.status = CASE WHEN c.expires_at > NOW(6) THEN 'AVAILABLE' ELSE 'ENDED' END, mc.applied_order_id = NULL WHERE mc.applied_order_id = #{orderId} AND mc.status = 'RESERVED'

UPDATE member_coupons mc INNER JOIN coupons c ON c.id = mc.coupon_id SET mc.status = CASE WHEN c.expires_at > NOW(6) THEN 'AVAILABLE' ELSE 'ENDED' END, mc.applied_order_id = NULL, mc.used_at = NULL WHERE mc.applied_order_id = #{orderId} AND mc.status IN ('RESERVED', 'USED')
